critique: The black background, warm amber palette, sparse layout, and now roughly consistent number of lights across t1 and t4 are appropriate. However, the elements still read as dim brown shaded spheres with dark rims rather than bright, self-illuminated flickering bulbs/bokeh. The lights also substantially relocate between frames instead of remaining a mostly fixed light field whose intensity varies independently.

suggestions.why: Use an additive glow transfer mode so the orange sprites produce luminous halos instead of retaining dark, muddy spherical edges.
Keep nearly all bulbs bright enough to read as emitted light while retaining rapid visible flicker.
Lengthen particle life so the same bulbs persist between nearby frames rather than being replaced by a new field.
Reduce emission proportionally to the longer lifetime, preserving the current sparse population instead of accumulating many extra lights.
Remove force-driven positional motion so the decorative light positions stay stable and the animation is perceived primarily as flicker.
